agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario starts at theta=0.1 rad with sensor_noise=0.017 and large dt≈0.02. Controller receives noisy angle measurements causing incorrect force direction/magnitude. Energy grows from 1.28 to 17.03 via controller work, pole falls to -0.868 rad exceeding 0.8 limit at step 15. Removing sensor noise (0.0) eliminates failure.
